summary: Frontend-only review for Pricing + Price-based filtering (See all Surplus screen, price chips on /surplus and /browse-deals, price fallback rendering). All routes render without red-screens, testIDs are present and correctly wired, chip filtering interacts correctly, sort chips coexist with price chips on Browse Deals, and tapping a surplus card routes to /drop/{id}. Live data only had ONE surplus item (₹40 / orig ₹100) and ZERO browse-deals items (backend confirmed via /api/drops and /api/browse-deals), so I could not exercise a multi-price threshold cut nor a dp=null item on the live app — the chip logic was verified by code review. No red screens observed.

ui_bugs.issue: Home Surplus horizontal card computes discount as getDiscount(item.original_price, item.discounted_price) and unconditionally renders the '<n>% OFF' badge. For a surplus item where discounted_price is null/undefined, JS coerces null → 0 and the badge would render as '100% OFF' even though backend sets price = original_price (i.e. no real discount). The price row itself is guarded correctly with the activePrice fallback (strike hidden when original_price is not greater than active price), so this is an inconsistency only in the badge. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/home.tsx:117 and :128-130. Fix: gate the discount badge with `discount > 0` AND compute discount from activePrice = price ?? discounted_price ?? original_price (same pattern already used in /surplus surplus.tsx line 67/105).

action_items: Fix home.tsx renderSurplusCard so the discount badge uses activePrice and only renders when discount > 0 (mirrors /app/frontend/app/surplus.tsx). Prevents a '100% OFF' badge for surplus items where discounted_price is null/0.

Seed at least one ACTIVE vendor with several surplus items at ₹40, ₹150, ₹280 AND one with discounted_price null/0 (as originally suggested) so the chip thresholds and the ₹0-fallback path can be UI-verified end-to-end. Currently only one surplus item (₹40) exists so 'Under ₹100/200/300' all trivially keep the same single item and there is no null-dp item on the app to visually verify.
critical_code_review_comments: activePrice fallback: /app/frontend/app/surplus.tsx (line 23) and /app/frontend/app/restaurant/[id].tsx MenuRow surplus path (line 266-270) correctly use `price ?? discounted_price ?? original_price` and gate strike/% with a real comparison — good.

/app/frontend/app/browse-deals.tsx (line 174) filters via `(d.price ?? d.original_price) < priceMax`. Since Browse Deals items always carry a computed `price`, this is equivalent to activePrice for that feed — OK.

Route `/surplus` is registered in _layout.tsx (line 154) and the See all link (testID `see-all-surplus`) is added to home.tsx (line 397). Navigation confirmed to `/surplus` and card taps confirmed to `/drop/{item_id}`.

Both new chip rows use identical testIDs `price-0 / price-100 / price-200 / price-300` on /surplus and /browse-deals — matches spec. Sort chips on /browse-deals (`sort-price`, `sort-discount`, `sort-distance`) still render and still work alongside the new price row.
Minor: home.tsx renderSurplusCard discount computation inconsistency (see ui_bugs above).
